newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via 4-day fixed system Repos.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via 4-day fixed system Repos.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York added temporary reserves to the banking system Thursday via four-day fixed system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokesman said.
The move was in line with market expectations.

At 1130 EST/1630 GMT federal funds were trading at 5-5/16 percent, above the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target. Analysts said the market is still expecting the Fed to add permanent reserves to the banking system through a coupon pass operation soon, but not necessarily today.
